date_note: Leak-site listing seen Nov 18; no intrusion date given.
title: The Gentlemen ransomware group lists Nvidia on its leak site
summary: The Gentlemen ransomware group listed Nvidia on its extortion site on November 18, with the message "DATA INFO - SOON" and a countdown of just under 10 days. Cyber Security News reports the listing includes no sample files and that Nvidia has not publicly confirmed a breach. This is an unverified attacker claim.
plain: A ransomware gang says it hacked Nvidia and threatens to leak data in about ten days. It has shown no proof, and Nvidia has not confirmed it.
exec: An unconfirmed claim against a major company; no evidence of a breach has been published.
action: No action needed; for awareness. Nvidia partners should watch for official statements and treat unsolicited messages about the claim with caution.

validation.note: IBTimes, Cyber Security News and the ransomware.live listing report the group's claim; Nvidia has not confirmed. The Cybernews page was blocked.
